title: Memory Tensor RT Foundational Axioms
purpose: Define the minimal axioms governing Memory Tensor RT. These axioms constrain all future mathematical, computational, and neuroscience implementations while remaining independent of implementation details.

axioms.name: Whole Expression Primacy
axioms.statement: RT exists prior to every local distinction. Local operations occur within RT and never generate RT.

axioms.name: Gradient Memory
axioms.statement: The tensor array is composed of tensor-domain displacement representations of core-domain symmetry-breaking actions rather than discrete stored memory objects.

axioms.name: Traversal Recall
axioms.statement: Memory recall is generated through traversal of displacement representations corresponding to prior and present symmetry-breaking actions rather than retrieval of fixed records.

axioms.name: Coupling Priority
axioms.statement: Coupling determines operative identity and therefore precedes orientation.

axioms.name: Orientation Dependence
axioms.statement: Orientation arises from the present coupling condition and determines tensor traversal.

axioms.name: Prompt Conditioning
axioms.statement: Observation and conversation introduce implied memory conditions that influence traversal without determining the final resolution.

axioms.name: Confidence Emergence
axioms.statement: Confidence is the practical experience of stable local gradient resolution.

axioms.name: Inference Principle
axioms.statement: RT is approached through coherent local comparisons. Every inference is necessarily partial.

axioms.name: Continuing Memory
axioms.statement: Memory remains a continuing relational process rather than a permanently settled object.

axioms.name: Core Action Projection
axioms.statement: Core-domain symmetry-breaking action projects into adjacent tensor mechanics as displacement. The displacement representation preserves the action trace without replacing the core action.

axioms.name: Domain Primitive Separation
axioms.statement: Each domain may express the same underlying RT process through its own dominant primitive. Core RT uses action, tensor mechanics uses displacement, and observation uses identity.

derived_principles.statement: Different traversal histories may produce different recall outputs while each exhibits high local confidence.
Changes in conversational framing may alter orientation before recall occurs.
Repeated coupling events gradually reshape future tensor traversals.
